# Cloud Giant (`monsters:cloud-giant`)
*Huge giant, neutral* | **CR** 9 (XP 5,000; PB +4)
**AC** 14 | **HP** 200 (16d12 + 96) | **Speed** 40 ft., fly 20 ft., hover True
**STR** 27 (+8) | **DEX** 10 (+0) | **CON** 22 (+6) | **INT** 12 (+1) | **WIS** 16 (+3) | **CHA** 16 (+3)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: CON](../proficiencies/saving-throw-con.md) +10, [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +7
**Skills:** [Skill: Insight](../proficiencies/skill-insight.md) +7, [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +11
**Senses:** Passive Perception 21
**Languages:** Common, Giant

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The giant makes two attacks, using Thunderous Mace or Thundercloud in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Fog Cloud.
- **Thunderous Mace.** Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage.
- **Thundercloud.** Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 240 ft. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.
- **Spellcasting.** The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
  - At will: [Detect Magic](../spells/detect-magic.md) (level 1), [Fog Cloud](../spells/fog-cloud.md) (level 1), [Light](../spells/light.md)
  - 1/day: [Control Weather](../spells/control-weather.md) (level 8), [Gaseous Form](../spells/gaseous-form.md) (level 3), [Telekinesis](../spells/telekinesis.md) (level 5)

## Bonus Actions
- **Misty Step.** The giant casts the Misty Step spell, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
  - Other: [Misty Step](../spells/misty-step.md) (level 2)
